project_skeleton.description: Project skeleton definition specifying language, framework, and module layout.

language.description: Programming language (e.g., python, typescript, go). Use lowercase/kebab-case.

framework.description: Web framework (e.g., fastapi, nextjs, gin). Use lowercase/kebab-case.

modules.description: List of top-level modules or packages in the project skeleton.

interface_map.description: Mapping of API interfaces to their HTTP methods and paths.

interface_ref.description: Reference to the interface definition in the API contracts spec.

method.description: HTTP method for this interface route.

items.description: An API interface mapping binding an interface reference to an HTTP method and path.

validators.description: List of validation checks that have been run against the scaffold.

command_ref.description: Canonical reference for the scaffold CLI command.

build_status.description: Current build status of the scaffold: pending (not built), green (passing), or red (failing).

trace.description: Traceability links connecting this scaffold to related artifacts.

items.description: A traceability reference for this scaffold.

links.description: External links to related scaffold resources or documentation.

items.description: An external link related to this scaffold.
